The retrieved docs cover the pieces but not a complete global setup, so I can't give you a fully verified snippet.

**What the docs support:**

- The global pattern for embeddings is to set it on `Settings`: "# changing the global default" followed by `Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()` [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]. You would swap in a Hugging Face embedding class in that same place.
- For the HF side, the docs say "`HuggingFaceEmbedding`, which runs any [Sentence Transformers](https://sbert.net/) model on your own hardware." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/privacy.md]. The retrieved excerpts don't show its import path or constructor.
- For Ollama, the docs show "from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama" and `model="llama3.3",` with `context_window=8000` [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/using_llms.md].

**Putting it together** (the `Settings.llm` assignment is my inference from the `Settings.embed_model` pattern, not a quoted line):

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_index.embeddings.huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbedding  # import path from general knowledge, not the retrieved docs

Settings.llm = Ollama(model="llama3.3", request_timeout=60.0, context_window=8000)
Settings.embed_model = HuggingFaceEmbedding(model_name="BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5")  # example model name
```

Set both before you build any index or query engine, so nothing falls back to a default.

**What I don't know from these docs:**

- Whether LlamaIndex contacts OpenAI when `Settings.llm` or `Settings.embed_model` is unset. Setting both explicitly should avoid that, but I can't confirm the default behavior from the excerpts.
- The exact `HuggingFaceEmbedding` import path and constructor arguments. Check the embeddings local-models section the docs point to.
